name: DAYANG
recent: Dayang 最新季度 (截至 2026 年 9 月) 净利同比下跌 52%，并预警离岸作业放缓将令后续表现走弱。多家券商下调盈利预测，认为复苏要到 FY27 下半年。同期 EPF 与 Aberdeen 系基金多次申报股权变动。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，净利同比下跌 52%。
公司预警离岸作业放缓将令未来表现走弱。
EPF 与 Aberdeen 系基金在 10 月至 11 月间多次申报股权变动。
risks: 净利同比大幅下滑，且公司预警后续表现走弱。
券商下调营收与每股盈利预测，认为复苏要到 FY27 下半年。
主要机构股东 (EPF、Aberdeen 系) 近期频繁申报股权变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收 1.6118 亿 MYR，净利 3284 万 MYR，净利率 20.4%；营收环比增 21.8%、净利环比增 52.6%，但营收同比减 39.7%、净利同比减 57.2%。

recent_en: Dayang's latest quarter (ended Sep 2026) saw net profit fall 52% year-on-year, and the company warned of weaker performance ahead as offshore work slows. Several brokers cut earnings forecasts, expecting recovery only in 2H FY27. Meanwhile, EPF and Aberdeen-related funds filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests.
notable_en: Reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026, with net profit down 52% year-on-year.
The company warned that slower offshore work will weaken future performance.
EPF and Aberdeen-related funds filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests between October and November.
risks_en: Net profit fell sharply year-on-year, and the company warned of weaker performance ahead.
Brokers cut revenue and EPS estimates, expecting recovery only in 2H FY27.
Major institutional shareholders (EPF, Aberdeen-related) have frequently reported changes in their holdings recently.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was MYR 161.18 million and net income MYR 32.84 million, with a net margin of 20.4%; revenue rose 21.8% and net income 52.6% quarter-on-quarter, but revenue fell 39.7% and net income 57.2% year-on-year.
